purpose: Create a candidate after questionnaire completion and explicit contact consent.
serverRules: Resolve tenant from authenticated session or verified server-side Client ID.
Never trust tenant_id supplied by the browser.
Validate and normalize email and phone.
Persist answers and scores as structured JSON.
Set status to new on creation.
Record consent only when the user explicitly submits the contact form.
Return only the candidate id and non-sensitive confirmation data.
